name: experiment-workers-issues
//: Deploy-only probe: which ways of reporting an error does Workers Issues detect, and how does it group them? Nebula logs through @lumenize/debug, which writes every level as one pretty-printed JSON string through console.debug. Each route here is one way an error can leave a Worker or a Durable Object, and every message starts with its route's letter so an issue in the dashboard names its source. See RESULTS.md.
